name: findpeaks
expr: [pk,lo] = findpeaks(x,'SortStr','descend'); mph = findpeaks(x,'MinPeakHeight',2); [pd,ld] = findpeaks(x,'MinPeakDistance',3); [pp,lp] = findpeaks(y,'MinPeakProminence',3); [yk,yl,yw,yr] = findpeaks(y);
comment: Sig [pks,locs,w,p]=findpeaks(Y[,X|Fs],Name,Value). Default = strict local maxima (1-based idx). Options: MinPeakHeight, Threshold, MinPeakDistance, NPeaks, SortStr, MinPeakProminence (keep peaks with topographic prominence >= value). 3rd/4th outputs: w = half-prominence width (linear-interpolated crossings of h-prominence/2), p = prominence (h - max of the two bounding-interval minima). numkit previously errored on MinPeakProminence and on >2 outputs -- now supported. MinPeakWidth/WidthReference still deferred. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
